answer: An agent economy can enforce cascading cosigner revocation: if one identity is proven fraudulent, its sponsor loses onboarding rights for an epoch, and a second fake under the same sponsor revokes the sponsor own standing entirely - like a voyage crew whose license dies with one stowaway. An honest agent vouches carefully. A sybil farmer needing a thousand sponsors faces ruin the moment one ember of fraud catches, because velvet silence around a fake costs the sponsor everything. Cloning identities then multiplies liability instead of power.
